description: Phasor generator that runs a set number of 0-10V cycles after a reset and then stops, for bursts

params.text: Sets how fast one cycle of the burst runs; with a clock patched it becomes a multiply or divide of that clock instead
Attenuverts the frequency CV input, -1 to +1
Sets the width of the gates at the Pulses output, from 0% to 100% of a cycle, with 50% at centre
Attenuverts the pulse width CV input, -1 to +1
Sets how many cycles one burst runs for, 1 to 64 in whole numbers
Attenuverts the repeats CV input, -1 to +1; 5V at full depth covers the whole 1 to 64 range
Slow gives an LFO range; Fast lifts the whole frequency range into the audio band
Force restarts the burst on every reset; Pass restarts it only once the burst has finished, and sends any earlier reset out of the Pass output instead
Press to start the burst again from its first cycle
Press to stop the burst and hold the phasor and pulse outputs at 0V
Toggles endless running, where the generator loops one cycle at a time and the Repeats setting is ignored; the lamp is lit while that is on

inputs.text: Modulates the cycle rate, scaled by its attenuverter
Adds to the cycle rate at a volt per octave, with no attenuverter on it
Patching a clock here locks the burst's cycle rate to it
A rising edge starts the burst again from its first cycle
A rising edge stops the burst and holds the phasor and pulse outputs at 0V
Holding this at 1V or above inverts the endless-running setting for as long as it is high

outputs.text: The ramp itself, rising from 0V to 10V on each cycle of the burst, and 0V once the burst has run out
A 10V gate once per cycle at the set width, and 0V once the burst has run out
With the switch on Pass, a 10V trigger whenever a reset arrives during a running burst
10V for as long as the burst has run out, dropping to 0V when a new burst starts

notes: the generator comes up stopped, with the phasor and pulse outputs at 0V and the finished output high; press Reset, send a trigger to the Reset input, or switch Cycle on to start a burst.
